title: Parliament consultative committee discusses foreign campuses, student exchanges

ai.summary: Union education minister Pralhad Joshi chaired a meeting on internationalising Indian education, discussing foreign university campuses, student exchanges, and CBSE schools abroad. The committee highlighted 268 CBSE schools operating globally and plans to expand Indian universities overseas.

facts.claim: 268 CBSE-affiliated schools were functioning across 26 countries
facts.quote: 268 CBSE-affiliated schools were functioning across 26 countries

facts.claim: The ministry has an overseas regional office in Dubai
facts.quote: with an overseas regional office in Dubai

facts.claim: Around 21 foreign higher education institutions were currently operational in India
facts.quote: around 21 foreign HEIs were currently operational in India

ai.background_note: The committee focused on expanding Indian education globally through foreign campuses and student exchanges, with CBSE schools already operating internationally.
